extDescription: Save open tabs into named, color-coded groups and restore them anytime. Works offline, with optional encrypted sync (Pro).
commandSaveCurrentTab: Save the current tab to TabMerger
commandSaveTabsLeft: Save tabs to the left of TabMerger
commandSaveTabsRight: Save tabs to the right to TabMerger
commandSaveOtherTabs: Save all other tabs to TabMerger
